## Progress

- [PR #53](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/53): `Money` (long minor units + ISO currency, checked, rates rounded half away from zero) in BuildingBlocks.Domain; new Billing module with DOC_SEQUENCE (`billing.DocSequences`) per tenant, country, doc type, financial year and prefix, incremented by MERGE WITH (HOLDLOCK) inside the issuing transaction; EF filter + RLS; `medvya_billing` role without DELETE
- Country rules: India `INV/25-26/00042` (April–March, max 16 characters), UAE `TI-AD-00042` (continuous series: the design carries no year); amount in words (lakh/crore, million) matches the design examples
- Tests on SQL Server 2022: 110 concurrent issues with 10 failing give exactly 1..100, rollback returns its number, FY rollover per prefix, cross-tenant blocked; no float/decimal in domain types or database columns; mutation-checked (unlocked increment, side-connection increment, RLS off, DELETE grant, rounding, overflow)
- Review fix (PR #66): trigger `TR_DocSequences_OnlyMoveForward` stops the app role's UPDATE from rewinding, skipping or moving a series (it was only denied DELETE); MERGE output goes INTO a table variable; Money operators throw ArgumentNullException on null
- Fix (numbering capacity and words): India prefixes 1–3 characters so every series reaches 999,999 numbers a financial year within the 16 characters of [CGST Rule 46(b)](https://taxinformation.cbic.gov.in/content/html/tax_repository/gst/rules/cgst_rules/active/chapter6/rule46_v1.00.html) (5-digit padding, grows past it); the number after the last that fits is refused with `series_exhausted` before the MERGE changes anything, so no number is taken and the caller's transaction stays usable; "one paisa" / "two paise" (fils unchanged); mutation-checked (length guard, prefix limit, paisa)
- Decided: UAE keeps one continuous, gap-free series with no yearly reset (VAT Executive Regulation Art. 59: sequential number, or a unique number identifying the invoice and its order; the FTA flags gaps; [Mondaq](https://www.mondaq.com/sales-taxes-vat-gst/670546/tax-invoice-under-uae-vat-law), [Wafeq](https://www.wafeq.com/en-ae/tax-and-reporting/vat-invoice-requirements-in-uae)). Amount in words follows the Indian convention ("and" only before paise or fils, "only" ends the phrase, no "and zero paise"; [Manager forum](https://forum.manager.io/t/amount-in-words-bug-india-paisa-paise/22703), [Petpooja](https://blog.petpooja.com/free-tools/amount-in-words-converter-free/)). Cash rounding is decided and recorded as acceptance criteria in MDV-P4-004 (India invoice round-off), MDV-P4-009 (UAE cash collection) and MDV-P4-012 (day close)
- Left: issuing invoices and per-facility prefix configuration (MDV-P4-004), cash rounding (MDV-P4-004/009/012), sign-off of the printed formats (MDV-P4-031)

## Description

Money value object (bigint minor units + ISO currency), rounding rules per currency, amount-in-words (Indian lakh/thousand; AED). DOC_SEQUENCE per tenant, country, doc type (receipt, invoice, credit, advance), financial year (India Apr–Mar) and prefix, incremented gaplessly inside the issuing transaction.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** No floating-point money anywhere in domain/database (architecture test on property types).
- [ ] **AC2.** Concurrent issuing of 100 invoices produces 100 consecutive numbers with no gaps or duplicates (test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Financial-year rollover starts a new sequence per configured prefix.
- [ ] **AC4.** Amount in words matches the design examples for INR and AED.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
